CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[FieldLookupValueByFieldTypeID] ( @fieldTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE
AS return( SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID as Value, A.DisplayValue as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetDetail A on T.LookupObjectID = A.TypeID and A.[Object] = 'Artifact' INNER JOIN AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) WHERE not exists ( select 1 from intersecttype it inner join [predicate] p on it.predicateid = p.id and p.[type] = 3 and it.[subject] = 'ArtifactType' and it.[object] = 'ArtifactType' and it.objectid = A.TypeID) and coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat) = ATT.DisplayFormat and T.ID = @fieldTypeID and T.LookupObjectType = 'Artifact'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetDetail A on T.LookupObjectID = A.TypeID and A.[Object] = 'Artifact' and T.LookupObjectType = 'Artifact' INNER JOIN AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) WHERE not exists ( select 1 from intersecttype it inner join [predicate] p on it.predicateid = p.id and p.[type] = 3 and it.[subject] = 'ArtifactType' and it.[object] = 'ArtifactType' and it.objectid = A.TypeID) and coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat) <> ATT.DisplayFormat and T.ID = @fieldTypeID
UNION ALL
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetDetail A on T.LookupObjectID = A.TypeID and A.[Object] = 'Artifact' and T.LookupObjectType = 'Artifact' WHERE exists ( select 1 from intersecttype it inner join [predicate] p on it.predicateid = p.id and p.[type] = 3 and it.[subject] = 'ArtifactType' and it.[object] = 'ArtifactType' and it.objectid = A.TypeID) and T.ID = @fieldTypeID
union
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType as LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID as LookupObjectID, R.ResourceID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, R.ResourceID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN reporting.Global_Resource R on T.ID = @fieldTypeID where T.LookupObjectType = 'Resource'
union
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetDetail A on T.LookupObjectID = A.TypeID and A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItem' and T.LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' INNER JOIN AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID
union
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetType A on A.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and T.LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItemType' WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID
union
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetDetail A ON T.LookupObjectType = 'Taxonomy' AND T.LookupObjectID = A.TypeID and A.[Object]='Taxonomy' WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID
union
SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetType A on A.Object = 'TaxonomyType' and T.LookupObjectType = 'TaxonomyType' WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID )
